applicationPortal.value: Apply through the Kent State University graduate application, then request the required audition for the Glauser School of Music. Kent State's Glauser School page states there is no separate application required for admission to the Glauser School of Music. Graduate audition requirement: all students pursuing a graduate degree in Performance, Composition, or Conducting must complete an audition or interview. Program admission requirements for Music Performance M.M. include an official transcript or copy of an official transcript from each college or university attended, three letters of recommendation, goal statement, resume or curriculum vitae, and audition. Music GPA note: the Music Performance M.M. catalog lists a minimum 3.0 undergraduate GPA for unconditional admission.

applicationFee.value: Application fee: domestic application fee $50; international application fee $70. Kent State says the application fee is required, non-refundable, payable with electronic check or credit card, and that no fee waivers are available.

auditionRequirements.value: Audition requirement: graduate students pursuing the M.M. in Performance must audition or interview. Prescreening: Kent State states that prescreenings are not required for most candidates, with conducting named as the exception; the Piano & Collaborative Piano page does not publish a piano prescreening requirement. Audition formats: students may complete the audition live in person, live virtually, or by pre-recorded video. Live virtual auditions: for scholarship and graduate assistantship consideration, live virtual auditions should be completed by February 28, 2026. Pre-recorded video audition: applicants should submit one video for each required piece or selection; for scholarship and graduate assistantship priority consideration, pre-recorded videos must be submitted by February 28, 2026. General admission video deadline: pre-recorded audition videos are accepted until August 7, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. EST. Piano page notes: sight-reading may be included in the audition.

repertoireRequirements.value: Prescreening repertoire: No prescreening repertoire is published for Piano Performance; Kent State states prescreenings are not required for most candidates, with conducting listed as the exception. Final audition repertoire: Four works representing at least three different style periods. Final audition repertoire: The program must include a complete classical sonata. Final audition repertoire: All selections composed prior to 1950 should be memorized. Additional repertoire notes: Sight-reading may be included.

deadlines.value: Scholarship and graduate assistantship priority deadline for pre-recorded video auditions: February 28, 2026. Live virtual auditions should be completed by February 28, 2026 for scholarship and graduate assistantship consideration. General admission deadline for pre-recorded audition videos: August 7, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. EST. International graduate application deadline for Fall admission: May 15. International application deadline for Spring admission: November 1. International application deadline for Summer admission: March 1.

englishScores.value: Applicability: all international applicants must provide proof of English language proficiency unless they meet Kent State's published exceptions. Program-specific graduate Music Performance minimum scores: TOEFL PBT 525. Program-specific graduate Music Performance minimum scores: TOEFL iBT 71. Program-specific graduate Music Performance minimum scores: MELAB 74. Program-specific graduate Music Performance minimum scores: IELTS 6.0. Program-specific graduate Music Performance minimum scores: PTE Academic 50. Program-specific graduate Music Performance minimum scores: Duolingo English Test 100. Notes: Kent State states that individual graduate programs may require higher scores than the general university minimums; the Music Performance M.M. catalog uses the scores listed here. General English proficiency page note: official TOEFL scores must be sent directly from ETS and Kent State's institution code is 1367.
